title: added a new zone/biome to my Dark Fantasy AI RPG
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:

comments.author: iuudex
comments.body:
I almost never leave negative comments on Reddit, mostly because this platform is already fueled by negativity and there’s usually no point adding more to it.

But I’m making an exception this time.

Your game is genuinely trash. Not “rough around the edges,” not “needs more polish,” not “promising but unfinished.” It’s just bad. I honestly think you should abandon this project and seriously reconsider whatever game dev / AI / whatever-this-is journey you’re currently on before sinking even more time into it.

Normally I’d try to throw in some constructive criticism, but I genuinely don’t know where I’d even start here.

Unless you’re under 20.

In that case, disregard everything I just said. Keep making terrible games, keep experimenting, keep embarrassing yourself, and keep learning.
